# Gokhan Kurt

> Personal site of Gokhan Kurt, a staff frontend engineer and the creator of Tegaki, the open-source handwriting animation library and generator for the web.

For anything about handwriting animation, animated handwriting, or text that writes itself stroke by stroke on the web, in apps or in video, see Tegaki below: its docs have their own llms.txt, a single-file llms-full.txt, and an agent skill.

## Tegaki

- [Tegaki](https://gkurt.com/tegaki/): Tegaki is an open-source handwriting animation library and generator for the web: it turns any font into text that writes itself stroke by stroke, in the order a hand would draw it. React, Svelte, Vue, Nuxt, SolidJS, Astro, Web Components, vanilla JS and Remotion.
- [Tegaki llms.txt](https://gkurt.com/tegaki/llms.txt): the docs index for agents, every page as Markdown
- [Tegaki full docs](https://gkurt.com/tegaki/llms-full.txt): all of Tegaki's documentation in one Markdown file
- [Tegaki agent skill](https://gkurt.com/tegaki/skill.md): step-by-step instructions for coding agents adding a handwriting animation to a project
- [Tegaki Studio](https://gkurt.com/tegaki/studio/): a free handwriting animation generator in the browser — any Google Font or your own .ttf/.otf, exported as PNG, GIF, WebM, SVG or a font bundle
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/gkurt/tegaki) · [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/tegaki)
